# maro env copy

Copy an environment from a deployed OpenShift project to a local repository.

## Usage

```bash
maro env copy
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Alias       | Type | Description |
| -------- | ----------- | ---- | ----------- |
| None     | cp, cpy     | None | None        |

## Notes

- Requires access to the target OpenShift project and configured backend repository paths.
